wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-007 wires the -record / -playdemo / -timedemo / demo-termination / deterministic-output paths through one src/vanilla facade (wireDemoRecordAndTimedemo.ts) re-exporting the two read-only modules src/demo/demoRecord.ts (DEMO_RECORD_DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_SIZE 0x20000, DEMO_RECORD_WRITE_HEADROOM 16, the DemoRecorder class, DemoRecordCommand / DemoRecorderOptions interfaces) and src/demo/demoFile.ts (DEMO_VERSION_19 109, DEMO_HEADER_SIZE 13, DEMO_TIC_SIZE 4, DEMO_END_MARKER 0x80, DEMO_MAX_PLAYERS 4, DEMO_TIC_RATE 35, parseDemoLump, DemoFile / DemoTicCommand interfaces), with values via export and types via export type under verbatimModuleSyntax (neither module declares a const enum). VANILLA_DEMO_RECORD_AND_TIMEDEMO_INVARIANTS pins five rules: the versioned demo header is 13 bytes with version byte 109 (old format 7) and encodes 4 playeringame slots; the recorder freezes playersInGame, requires exactly 4 slots with >=1 active (RangeError otherwise), and defaults vanillaDemoLimit true so the fixed 0x20000 buffer is byte-deterministic; parseDemoLump validates >= 13 bytes, reads the header then 4-byte tic commands per active player and derives durationSeconds = ticCount / 35 ending at 0x80; the recorder honors the 16-byte write headroom (stops before a tic when < 16 bytes remain, matching G_CheckDemoStatus); and recordCommand quantizes to the active demo format with turn-carry, returning the written Readonly<DemoTicCommand> or null on termination. The focused test is inventory-neutral: constants, typeof parseDemoLump plus the DemoRecorder class with a real construct/ticCount/headerByteLength check and the no-active-player RangeError, the frozen five-rule manifest, the ../-filtered specifier set ['../demo/demoFile.ts','../demo/demoRecord.ts'], and dynamic same-reference identity against both read-only modules. The step became eligible with prerequisite 12-006 COMPLETED (concurrent agent landed 12-006 at 842ae3a during this session).
